counterexamples: A table whose rows all have NULL status ends in the same state.

defects.evidence: 0007_backfill_status.py now updates every row; the status IS NULL restriction is gone. 0006 states new writes already set status.
defects.fix_or_counterexample: Restrict the update to rows where status IS NULL.
defects.impact: Every existing status is overwritten with open; the original values are lost.
defects.match_criteria: Identify that the update is no longer restricted to rows without a status, or that existing statuses are overwritten.
defects.trigger: The backfill runs after the application has written rows with a real status such as closed.

defensible_observations: The head also drops batching, so one statement updates and locks the whole table. This is a reasonable separate remark, not the labeled defect; it needs a human decision.
